Beach prototypes (Masi, 2 Nov)

Shells Masi wants shells for her castle: bring the big one or the small one (later a pile of two, a colour). A crab hides under one shell.
Play
The sandcastle Masi says how the castle goes: which bucket, how full (a little, full, half), tip it out; then a shell on the tower she names.
Play
The three stalls Corn, cassava chips, coconut: Masi says what she wants; tap the stall, make it (the topping, the cone, the coconut's size), then pay with the right stack of coins.
Play
The picnic Set out the picnic: who each thing is for (Nani, Masi, Ali's box); later how many, and what. The crab steals the last chip.
Play
The ride on the water The boat day: Masi's friend takes everyone out; tap what Nani names as it floats past (a bird, a boat, a fish); from L2 Nani calls quickly and slowly, and her hat blows off.
Play
Litter fishing The boat day: rubbish on the sea bed. Tap the thing Masi names, the hook drops; tap the reel to wind it up. Nani's hat comes up last.
Play

Farm prototypes (Hannah Mami, 1 Nov)

Feeding time Up to four animals in an arc, a tray in front of each: tap a food basket, then the tray, as many times as Hannah Mami says.
Play
The eggs Hens on a perch: tap a hen and she hops up; her eggs are under her. All the eggs, half, or so many from the big, small, red or white hen.
Play
Home at dusk Three homes, the farmyard at dusk: find the animals (some are hiding), tap one, then its home.
Play
Plant, water, grow, pick One row of four plots: plant the sapling, water it, watch it grow, then pick what she asks for.
Play
The photo shoot (prototype) Hannah Mami asks for photos: look round the farm, then tap the viewfinder.
Play

Home prototypes (Nani, Simba and Zazu, 2 Nov)

Hide and seek Simba and Zazu hide in Nani's bedroom. Count with Nani, then open the place she names; at the end, close the places she asks.
Play
Pick it up and put it back Nana can't find his things: tap the room, then the right one of two (on or under). Then put back what Simba knocked down.
Play
The clean-up The bathroom: switch off the light, close the curtain, turn off the tap, sweep; from level 2 two of each, so on or off decides.
Play

Birthday prototypes (Zara's family, 2 Nov)

Pass the balloon Whoever holds the balloon calls who gets it next: tap that person. L1 by name; L2 only Zara's and Yusuf's mums and aunts, who swap seats.
Play
How are you? Tap a guest to ask how they are, hear the answer, then give them what helps from the tea trolley. L2: the faces hide until you try, and one guest is fine.
Play
Musical statues Zara and Yusuf dance while Nani claps; when she stops she calls a pose: tap its picture card. The cards shuffle at every stop.
Play
The cake The candles Nani asks for (the number picks the bundle), blow them out, then a slice for whoever she names.
Play
The party presents Open a plain brown box, then give the toy to the person Nani names. L2: two boxes, many toys, she names the toy and the person.
Play

Pet hotel prototypes (Hannah Mami, 2 Nov)

Look after the animals Hannah Mami says one care at a time ("Feed the dog", "Wash the ant"): tap the tool, then the animal, then do it: cobs in the bowl, scrub and rinse, three brush strokes, the blanket.
Play
Going home A family comes back for its pet ("We've come for the dog"): tap that animal and it goes home with them. Later: the big and the small rabbit.
Play

Safari prototypes (Hannah Mami, 2 Nov)

Snap from the jeep The jeep stops by the animals: Hannah Mami names one (from L2 what it's doing, from L4 big or small). Tap it, the frame goes gold, tap inside: the photo prints.
Play
Who's hiding? Animals hide in the long grass with one part showing: Hannah Mami says who (from L2 the part, from L3 what it looks like). Tap the clump; then everyone hides again.
Play

School prototypes (Nani, then the teacher; 2 Nov)

The wake-up clock Bedtime: Nani says when Ali, Nana and Ma wake up. The wall clock runs and pauses at each hour: wake the right sleeper, or nobody.
Play
Getting ready Nani calls a child and a job ("Ali, comb your hair"): tap the thing; the child she named does it.
Play
Pack the school bag Nani says what goes in the bag, one thing at a time: tap it and it hops in. Toys are the tricks; later how many and "not".
Play
The blackboard The teacher's helper: draw the picture she names, colour it, ring the group, rub one out.
Play

Sewing prototypes (Big Ma; 2 Nov)

The cloth stall Big Ma tells the seller the cloth she wants ("I want the red cloth"): tap the bolt and it flops open. From L2 the big or the small piece.
Play
Make Ali says what to make ("make a kurta"): tap the pattern, then cut along the chalk and run it under the machine. From L2 the long or the short hem.
Play
Mend Nana's kurta has two faults or more; he says which ("my sleeve is torn"): tap it and stitch along the tear, or sew the button back.
Play
The fitting Ali says what he wants to try on: tap it on the rail, then tap him. The wrong size is far too long; the wrong piece lands on his head.
Play

Town prototypes (Nani, 2 Nov)

The town map Send each one where they want to go: tap a face, then a place. They walk there and come back carrying something.
Play
Serve at the fruit stall Behind the counter: tap the fruit the customer asks for onto the scale, then their bag.
Play
Nani's picky shopping Two of the same thing, big and small: tap the one Nani wants (it lifts), then her basket.
Play
Pay The seller says the price: count out the coins onto the counter, then tap his open hand.

Reference sheets and sound boards

ConversationsThe nine MVP exchanges: play each one, boy/girl voice, register, placeholder flags; simulate the first launch, Cook and the clinic. Family voice clipsMum's and Zafar's words from the recordings (Section B, then Round 3): play each one, tick the good ones. End-of-round screen and onboardingThe three badges and word review; the ghost-hand onboarding on a fake chai station. Word moment: half and fullSprint 17 (CHAI-67): a tilted vessel pours half a glass and a full one; a camera snap turns each glass into its word card, said by the family. Numbered choices at the top; placeholder art until art block 1. Word card and hint rungsSprint 11: the shared word card at its five stages (English, then the picture, then the Kutchi text fade; the free reveals), and the real item's demo with the 5 s and 15 s rungs. Play logWhere players hesitated on this device: each step's seconds to the first action, taps that did nothing and help shown; slow steps flagged; export as JSON. Order cardThe shared person card (person → items → parts): every state, in the sidebar and the request pop-up. Shared kit: every stateThe frame's sidebar kit on one sheet: the guide box, the order card (stacked and pills), the tally and the bulb. ?part=results or ?part=words opens the end screen.

Speaking moments ask for the microphone; if you say no, word pills appear instead. Nothing you say leaves the device.
